'''Jered Pole''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]] who served in the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Around [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], he posed as a gambler where he started an [[Operation Starbird|information-gathering mission]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Goroth Prime/Legends|Goroth Prime]].
